mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, r.role_name from sys_user u inner join sys_user_project up on up.user_id = u.user_id and up.project_id = #{projectId} left join sys_user_project_role upr on upr.user_project_id = up.user_project_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = upr.role_id where u.del_flag = '0'
